# Vubbs

> Never make another social post. Vubbs generates carousels, reels, and images that don't look AI-generated — then publishes them to Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Threads, and Pinterest on autopilot.

## What Vubbs does

Vubbs is an AI social media platform that creates and publishes content for you. It writes, designs, and posts to your channels on a schedule, so an account keeps growing without anyone making posts for it. The output is built to read like a person runs the account — not like generated filler.

## Platforms

Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Threads, and Pinterest.

## What Vubbs creates

- Posts
- Carousels
- Reels

## Auto Carousel Creator

AI-generated carousel posts, multiple slides, ready to publish.

## Proof

25M+ views generated. Built by a team that's been deep in the edit — the same pipeline now runs live channels end to end.

Live channels: @theasterisk_vubbs, @truthserum.ai, @lecart.app, @chatme.us, @stage.by.vubbs

## Common questions

- Voice: you set tone, topics, and reference accounts once; everything is generated against that profile.
- Approval: review a queue before publishing, or run on full autopilot once you trust the output.
- Setup: your accounts, a short brief on what you want to be known for, and any brand assets you already have.
- Pricing: still being set ahead of launch. Waitlist members get early-access pricing.

Currently in private beta. Waitlist open at https://vubbs.com
